name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: A mutual NDA that allows two parties to disclose confidential information to each other in connection with a stated purpose, with standard obligations to protect and limit use of that information.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: A framework agreement for selling and buying cloud software and SaaS products, covering access and use of the service, support, payment, data privacy, warranties, liability, indemnification, and confidentiality.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: An agreement granting an early customer access to a product in exchange for feedback and participation in a design partner program, before a full commercial relationship is established.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: A companion agreement to a Cloud Service Agreement that sets uptime and support response time targets, how they are calculated, and the service credits or termination rights available if they are not met.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: An agreement governing the provision of professional services under one or more statements of work, covering deliverables, intellectual property, payment, warranties, liability, and confidentiality.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: A GDPR-oriented data processing agreement that documents how a provider processes personal data on behalf of a customer, including subprocessors, international data transfers, security incidents, and audit rights.

name: Software License Agreement
description: An agreement licensing on-premises or installed software to a customer, covering license scope, restrictions, updates, open source components, warranties, liability, and confidentiality.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: An agreement for business partnerships involving mutual obligations, a limited trademark license for co-marketing, payment terms, and standard warranty, liability, and confidentiality provisions.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: A short-term trial or evaluation agreement that lets a prospective customer test a product before committing to a longer-term commercial agreement, with limited scope and easier termination.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: A HIPAA-required agreement between a covered entity and a business associate that governs the use, disclosure, and safeguarding of protected health information (PHI).

name: AI Addendum
description: An addendum that supplements a commercial agreement to govern the use of AI features, including input and output ownership, model training restrictions, and AI-specific disclaimers.
